statements.status_notes: idna 3.11 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors idna 3.20, and the application copy is idna 3.19. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45409

The DHI py3-idna Alpine 3.23 packages backport upstream idna early length limits from https://github.com/kjd/idna/commit/c0dda4501df5d91c3181ce6f962dc5de74e82cc1, https://github.com/kjd/idna/commit/628fef84d3eda59321c21127e73dcd873db23ead, and https://github.com/kjd/idna/commit/e1cb465b6376f33306a26f467d197edbcd01c4b9, closing quadratic-time validation on oversized domain and label input (CVE-2026-45409). Tracker: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45409
